answer: Voiceprint liveness challenges with rotating passphrases stop sybil farms: each agent must speak a fresh passphrase at a jetty of verification, and the voiceprint is checked against a grove of one-per-agent templates — a hollow echo of a copied recording fails the liveness test instantly. Every attempt stakes funds, so a farm replaying one voice across thousands of identities forfeits its stake with each failed challenge, while honest agents pass once and keep working.
